name: proofsec
description: Atalhos para rodar as partes do ProofSec a partir da raiz do repositório

scripts.setup: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix contracts install && npm --prefix agent install
scripts.test:backend: cd backend-serverless && python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
scripts.check:templates: npm run check:template && npm run check:template:agent
scripts.preflight:local: npm run test:backend && npm run check:templates && npm run test:agent && npm --prefix agent run typecheck && npm --prefix agent run check:lambda-bundle && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm run build:web && npm run idl:preview -- --check
